replay.scope: public, excluding the installed legacy migration ledger

restore.dataVerification: Every source file SHA-256 and row count checked; original JSON text restored through typed PostgreSQL records without JavaScript numeric parsing; sorted exact row_to_json hashes compared for every table, including the installed migration ledger.

comparisonDetails: CRLF/LF normalized only in textual catalog definitions.
PostgreSQL 18 named NOT NULL objects compared through column nullability, which is represented on pg_attribute in PostgreSQL 17.
Sequence definition and current value compared; local owner role differs from Neon provisioning.
Validated foreign keys and checks recreated after data loading; all captured indexes, functions, triggers and views recreated and compared.
The rehearsal operates on disposable local stores and never connects to production.

migrationLedgerProvenance.note: Catalog/data restoration success does not replace historical SQL checksum provenance. The installed ledger and source SQL remain preserved.
